import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

# Setup directories and paths
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/ru_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/ru_test_2.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)


# Robust cleaning function for lookup keys
def clean_key(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    return str(text).strip().lower()


train_df["key"] = train_df["before"].apply(clean_key)
test_df["key"] = test_df["before"].apply(clean_key)

# Hold-out Validation Split (90/10)
rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
indices = rng.permutation(len(train_df))
split_idx = int(len(train_df) * 0.9)
train_mask = indices[:split_idx]
val_mask = indices[split_idx:]

train_split = train_df.iloc[train_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
val_split = train_df.iloc[val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Training size: {len(train_split)}, Validation size: {len(val_split)}")

# Build Lookup Table using cleaned keys
# Maps each normalized key to its most frequent original 'after' form
lookup_dict = (
    train_split.groupby("key")["after"]
    .agg(lambda x: x.value_counts().index[0])
    .to_dict()
)
print(f"Lookup table built with {len(lookup_dict)} unique mappings.")

# Evaluate on Validation Set
val_pred = val_split["key"].map(lookup_dict)
# Fallback for unseen tokens: preserve original input
val_pred = val_pred.fillna(val_split["before"])

# Compute token-level exact match accuracy
val_accuracy = (val_pred == val_split["after"]).mean()
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate Test Predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_pred = test_df["key"].map(lookup_dict)
test_pred = test_pred.fillna(test_df["before"])

# Format submission file according to spec
test_ids = test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "after": test_pred.astype(str)})

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH} with {len(submission_df)} rows.")
